units.source_text: 我站起身，想著先去買些什麼藥，便走進了附近的一家藥店，

en.t: I stood up, thinking I would first go buy some kind of medicine, and walked into a nearby pharmacy,

units.source_text: 在店裡與老闆娘打照面的瞬間，老闆娘像是被閃光燈照到了面孔，

en.t: the moment I came face to face with the proprietress inside, she looked as though a flashbulb had struck her face,

units.source_text: 抬頭睜大了雙眼，一動不動地呆立在原地。

en.t: she raised her head and opened her eyes wide, standing there frozen without moving at all.

units.source_text: 但她睜大的雙眼裡，感覺不到驚愕和厭惡之色，

en.t: But in those wide-open eyes I sensed neither astonishment nor disgust,

units.source_text: 而是流露出既像求救，又像愛慕的神情。

en.t: but rather an expression like a plea for help and also like affection.

units.source_text: 啊，這個人也肯定是不幸之人，

en.t: Ah, this person too must surely be unhappy,

units.source_text: 不幸之人總是敏感於別人的不幸。

en.t: for unhappy people are always sensitive to the unhappiness of others.

units.source_text: 正當我這樣想時，我發現那位老闆娘手拄著柺杖，顫悠悠地站著。

en.t: Just as I was thinking this, I noticed that the proprietress was standing unsteadily, leaning on a cane.

units.source_text: 我剋制住想衝過去的衝動，繼續與她面面相望時，淚水禁不住奪眶而出。

en.t: I held back the impulse to rush over to her, and as I continued to look at her face to face, tears came spilling out despite myself.
